column1: # ASDF build-target registry — single source of truth.
# Consumed by make-targets.sh (target list + build category)
# test/simavr/CMakeLists.txt (which targets the simavr tests run against)
# by CI. Keep this file as the only place target membership is defined.
#   category : avr | test | arm_m0+ | sim   (determines how the target is built)
#   simavr   : yes => exercised by the simavr integration tests (AVR only)
